request:
Leave requests for a 40-person company.
Roles: staff, manager, admin.
Screens: request form, my requests page, approvals dashboard.
- A staff member must be able to request leave for 1 to 30 days.
- A manager must approve or reject each request within the approvals dashboard.
- A request cannot overlap an approved request of the same person.
- An admin must be able to set each person's yearly allowance (default 25 days).
Given a request that exceeds the remaining allowance
When the staff member submits it
Then the form shows how many days are left and does not save.
